name: Peak-based Transfer Function Model
definition: A transfer function model where the function is defined as the sum of window functions called peaks. Each peak highlights a small voxel value range in a specific color. This model reduces the number of parameters a user has to modify compared to piecewise linear building blocks, while allowing flexible transfer functions.
summary: The Peak-based Transfer Function Model defines a transfer function as a sum of sinusoidal window functions, offering intuitive control for hand-held devices unlike Gaussian-based alternatives.
